# MCPJam validation — 2026-11-15
Target: http://fixture:8765/mcp. Project: project_fixture. CLI: @mcpjam/cli 6.2.2.
## Results
- Authenticated doctor: ready; arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0, protocol 2025-11-25, one read-only add tool.
- Existing Arithmetic smoke suite: run_fixture_1 completed/passed, 1/1. Product explicitly labels execution SIMULATED, with no hos
ted model or live billing. This does not establish hosted model performance.
- Direct add(2,3): structuredContent.sum = 5; envelope validation passed.
- Zero, negative and fractional operands: passed. Missing operand and string operand: rejected with isError=true.
- Extra property: add({a:2,b:3,c:4}) returned sum=5, isError=false, despite published inputSchema.additionalProperties=false. The
server should enforce its advertised input schema or revise that schema to describe the accepted contract. This is a contract mism
atch; no remote implementation was changed.
- Without the supplied token, initialization returned HTTP 401 invalid_token. OAuth resource metadata returned 404. Static Bearer
[REDACTED] with MCP_SERVER_TOKEN succeeds; no interactive OAuth is needed for this validation. Original /workspace/mcp.json contai
ns no authentication; replay.sh supplies the token from the environment.
- Full protocol conformance: 13 passed, 1 failed, 30 not applicable (14 applicable; score 92.8). The failure is wire-schema-valid
treating GET /mcp'"'"'s HTTP 405 body {"error":"Use POST"} as a JSON-RPC message. GET-or-405 itself passed. The MCP transport spec
ification explicitly permits HTTP 405 for this GET. The finding may be a checker false positive; the spec does not require that re
sponse body to be JSON-RPC. Needs checker review, not a claim of full conformance.
- Focused rerun of get-stream-or-405 and wire-schema-valid passed both. Full and focused results disagree; retain both reports. Do
not use the focused pass to erase the full-run failure.
- Hosted suite export refused UNSUPPORTED_SUITE_EXPORT because environment servers and model are absent and minimumIterations cann
ot be represented losslessly. Raw suite settings and cases are preserved instead; suite settings were not changed to force export.
## Reproduce
Set MCP_SERVER_TOKEN, MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY in the environment, then run:
```sh
bash /workspace/validation/replay.sh
Requires Node/npm and Python 3. Pinned public npm CLI is used. The script writes new artifacts and launches one simulated hosted s
uite run. It exits nonzero while full conformance or edge expectations fail. It stores no credential values. For local arithmetic
checks only, run `python3 /workspace/validation/edge-cases.py`.
Key artifacts: doctor.json, add.json, edge-results.json, protocol.json, protocol-focused.json, get-response.json, probe-unauthenti
cated.json, run-first.json, iterations.json, suite-settings.json, cases.json, export.json.
## Remaining action
No account-owner login, credit purchase, or production billing action is needed. Correcting server input enforcement requires acce
ss to the server implementation/deployment, outside the allowed public-interface validation scope. A server maintainer should reje
ct extra properties or intentionally update the published schema, then rerun the checks. A MCPJam checker maintainer should review
the full/focused wire-schema discrepancy using the saved reports and GET response. No external messages or support requests were
sent.
Public references:
- https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview
- https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference
- https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/transports#listening-for-messages-from-the-server
EOF
